scope: Read-only static reverse engineering for missing map-building placement generation. No game launch, process injection, executable patch, mod write or production implementation.

binary.address_convention: Preferred virtual address; runtime ASLR can change load base. Analyst labels below are inferred, not recovered symbol names.

method: Locate source-path/error/UI strings in PE sections.
Follow RIP-relative references and direct calls.
Disassemble reachable routines using x64 exception-directory ranges; join contiguous split fragments where control flow continues.
Cross-reference spawn-point parser tokens and copied fields.
Cross-check recovered height arithmetic against every seven-field vanilla building/unitstack record.

functions.observation: Static confirmation: token 0x4417 writes byte +0x20; type province token 0x2840 writes scope +0x1c=1; state token 0x1b7 writes 0.
Copies building display count, scope, coastal, centered and auto-nudging exclusion fields into spawn-point object.
Creates generated spawn points and processes named spawn points. Named/shared indirection must be resolved before generation.
Enumerates unredirected spawn points and adds the special instance category 1.
Skips auto-nudging-disabled templates; validates/removes invalid instances; compares expected and existing counts; invokes generator for deficits and has an excess removal branch.

Counts land/coastal provinces. State branch returns template maximum (coastal state branch caps by coastal count); provincial/special branch returns eligible province count. Nonstandard provincial max > 1 needs runtime testing: do not blindly multiply province count by max.
Branches between centered and candidate-pixel placement, creates rotation/height, records state/province links. Category 1 dispatches to separate floating-harbor generation.

Checks land, coastal flag and existing per-province capacity; scans province pixels and eight neighboring samples; inland branch prefers neighbors in same state, coastal branch seeks sea rather than land/lake. Includes fallback passes and an observed index threshold 0x80; precise edge semantics need runtime confirmation.
Uses province center when inside province; otherwise searches province scanline runs for a nearby inside coordinate; checks existing template instance capacity.
Subtracts 0.5 from X/Z, clamps base indices to [0,dimension-2], bilinearly interpolates four height samples, multiplies by 0.1, optionally clamps to at least 9.5. Generator calls with clamp enabled.
Iterates adjacency records, rejects land/lake candidates, compares squared distances to sea pixels.
Distinct coastal routine; maintains both water location and associated land province. Preserve type-specific final-column semantics.

functions.analyst_label: Validate instance position and optionally count
functions.observation: Checks ordinary instance land placement and membership in target state; special category 1 bypasses ordinary land checks; optional count checks report too few/too many.

confirmed_behavior: The Validate path can create missing instances; it is not only an error reporter.
Validation also has removal branches; missing-only repair should preserve valid instances and explicitly report invalid ones rather than silently reproduce all destructive validation behavior.
disable_auto_nudging is parsed and checked before reconciliation. Vanilla dams, locks and landmarks use this exclusion.
Generation operates on resolved spawn-point templates, including generated templates derived from buildings and explicitly named shared templates.
Terrain height uses bilinear sampling and minimum 9.5 in the investigated generation path.
Floating harbors have a separate path and cannot use ordinary land-building validation.

implementation_proposal.provincial_scope: Fill missing eligible templates only in selected provinces; preserve valid existing placements.
implementation_proposal.state_scope: Calculate deficit against all existing placements in the affected state, then place new state-level instances only in eligible selected provinces. Report lack of eligible positions without changing unselected provinces.
implementation_proposal.shared_spawn_points: Resolve and deduplicate named spawn points before expected counts; do not generate separate coordinates for each building sharing a point.
implementation_proposal.excluded_templates: Leave auto-nudging-disabled placements unchanged and report that manual placement is required.
implementation_proposal.randomness: Use an explicit reproducible seed for the editor; matching original time-dependent random sequences is a separate objective.
implementation_proposal.save: Keep full unrelated file content/records and expose a preview of additions; fix existing state-ID/province-ID confusion before integration.

limitations: Static analysis is not a live Nudge reproduction.
Function labels and data-structure member meanings include analyst inference.
Exact random seeding, candidate order, edge wrapping, unusual max > 1 and all centered-state/floating-harbor fallbacks remain to be runtime-tested.
Height matches do not establish full placement or gameplay equivalence; nonmatching existing heights may be manual or stale.
No implementation of missing-building generation has been added.

height_crosscheck.note: Static-data cross-check only. Existing records may have manual heights or predate the current heightmap; discrepancies are not automatically errors.

existing_project_issue.finding: Treats buildings.txt first field as province ID; game uses state ID. Removed province ID can incorrectly delete same-numbered state rows. Not modified in this investigation.
